vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nm-pensive-code-refinement
Version: 1.0.1

The nm-pensive-code-refinement skill bundle is a comprehensive static analysis toolset designed to identify code smells, algorithmic inefficiencies, and architectural violations. It utilizes sophisticated but safe shell-based logic (grep, awk, sed, find) across several modules (e.g., algorithm-efficiency.md, clean-code-checks.md) to analyze local source code. There are no indicators of data exfiltration, unauthorized network access, or malicious execution; all commands are restricted to read-only file discovery and pattern matching within the project directory.

llm.summary: This instruction-only code review skill appears purpose-aligned, but it may scan your project with shell commands, use optional external helper plugins, and record review evidence.

dimensions.detail: The visible artifacts consistently focus on code quality review: duplication, algorithmic efficiency, clean code, architecture, and error handling. No credential collection, destructive actions, or unrelated network behavior is shown.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow includes read-oriented shell commands that recursively inspect the current directory. This is coherent for code review, but users should run it only from the intended repository.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no packaged code, but the skill references external Night Market/Claude Code plugins and optional helper scripts that are not part of the provided artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Recursive source scanning with find/grep/sed/awk is proportionate to code refinement, with some exclusions for common dependency/cache folders, but it can still read all matching code under the working directory.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill asks for TodoWrite items and proof-of-work/report evidence. This is task-scoped and disclosed, with no background persistence or privileged credential use shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill looks safe to use for code quality review. Before installing or invoking it, make sure you run it only in the repository you want analyzed, review any optional external plugin/helper it may use, and avoid sharing generated reports if they contain private code or secrets.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to use shell commands to inspect files under the current directory. The commands are read-oriented and aligned with code quality analysis, but their scope depends on where the user runs the skill.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Run the skill from the intended repository root and review any proposed command before allowing execution in directories that contain unrelated private files.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may read and summarize source files in the current project tree while performing the review.

evidence.explanation: The module can use an optional helper script from another plugin if present. That helper is not included in the provided artifacts, although a manual fallback is documented.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Only install or rely on referenced external plugins and helper scripts from trusted sources, and review them separately if they will be used.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the optional external plugin is installed, the agent may execute code that was not reviewed as part of this skill package.

evidence.explanation: The workflow may store or write evidence, metrics, and code snippets into TodoWrite/proof-of-work records or a report. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but those artifacts may contain proprietary code details.
evidence.snippet: Document with `imbue:proof-of-work` (if available): ... `[E1]`, `[E2]` references for each finding ... Metrics before/after ... Fallback: ... capture evidence inline in the report

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review generated evidence and reports before sharing them, especially if your repository contains secrets, customer data, or proprietary code.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Generated notes or reports may preserve excerpts and analysis from your codebase.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses purpose-aligned read-only shell analysis and may rely on optional external plugin helpers, but no hidden execution, destructive behavior, or automatic mutation is shown.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account privileges, or delegated third-party authority are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill may record code review evidence in task notes or reports, but there is no artifact evidence of exfiltration or unrelated sensitive-data access.
